name: Sprocket
text: Adopt the **Claude Self-Improvement Skill Pack** to automate prompt tuning and routing. It’s the fastest way to reduce manual review cycles while keeping quality high—trade-off is initial setup time for long-term gains. Pair it with a **24-hour canary deployment to 5% of users** first. This limits blast radius while proving value quickly—trade-off is slower full rollout if issues arise.

name: Gauge
text: The 5% canary is a gamble on reputational damage—broken prompts leak to real users before we even know they’re broken. A safer play is to run the Skill Pack in a shadow mode first, logging outputs without affecting users, then only auto-apply changes that pass a manual review gate. Settle it by proving the shadow mode catches the same drift risks without exposing users.
